title: StateChange::changed uses String where Id/State newtypes exist
description: StateChange::changed is HashMap<String, HashMap<String, String>>. The outer key is an account ID (jmap_types::Id), the inner value is a state string (jmap_types::State). Both Id and State are newtypes over String already used elsewhere in the crate (Session::state: State, BlobUploadResponse::account_id: Id). Using raw String here diverges from the type conventions established by the rest of the codebase and makes it possible to accidentally pass a state string where an Id is expected.
